title: 非洲HIV相关肺炎婴儿的经验性结核治疗：一项多中心、随机、开放标签的优效性对照试验
originalTitle: [Articles] Empirical tuberculosis treatment in infants living with HIV hospitalised with severe pneumonia in Africa (EMPIRICAL): a multicentre, randomised, open-label, 2 × 2 factorial, controlled superiority trial
summary: 该研究针对非洲HIV感染婴儿严重肺炎，比较经验性结核治疗（eTB-T）与临床和微生物学指导策略的死亡率影响。结果显示eTB-T未显著优于传统策略，但非干预组婴儿在随访期间有较高比例开始结核治疗，可能削弱了两组差异的统计学检测能力。研究完整数据可通过原文链接获取。
author: Sara Domínguez-Rodríguez, Alfredo Tagarro, Cinta Moraleda, W Chris Buck, Hilda Mujuru, Chishala Chabala, Tisungane Mvalo, Pui-Ying Iroh-Tam, Anélsio Cossa, Lola Madrid, Jahit Sacarlal, Alfeu Passanduca, Uneisse Cassia, Stella Langa, Hellen Tukamuhebwa Aanyu, Abner Tagoola, Constantine Mutata, Bwendo Nduna, Elizabeth Nkosi, Lughano Ghambi, Matthew Bates, Sheila Fernández-Luis, Kajal Chhaganlal, Sara Machava, Damalie Nalwanga, Denis Nansera, Mutsa Bwakura-Dangarembizi, Natasha Namuziya, Franklyn Nkongho Egbe, John Tembo, Álvaro Ballesteros, Raoul Moh, Lilit Manukyan, David Lora, Olivier Marcy, Tom G Jacobs, David Burger, Quique Bassat, Valeriane Leroy, Alessandra Nardone, Victor Musiime, Pablo Rojo, Empirical Clinical Trial Group
